cards.card_text: So David takes his six hundred men to Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath, a Philistine city.
cards.verse_text: So David set out with his six hundred men and went to Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath.
cards.snippet: …out with his six hundred men and went to Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath.
